scope: Midpoint quadrature only, fixed saved GT and prescribed perturbation; no optimization

design.scope: Old-development numerical ray-step diagnostic only; no registration or endpoint-based tuning

perturbation.applies_to: each of the five vertebrae; all other local rotation-vector/translation coordinates unchanged
perturbation.definition: add to original local parameter coordinates, not a composition with a global rigid transform

design.sample_cap_policy: Choose a cap at least ceil(component physical diagonal / smallest requested h) for every tested component and assert no cap activation; record actual cap, N, diagonal and ray interval statistics
design.comparison: full-image neighboring-step relative L2 and original NCC loss, separately by case/view/pose; preserve intensity scale, detector, interpolation and integration bounds
design.production_reference: Also record whether uncapped h=1 N equals original h=1/cap192 production N for each component; any disagreement is a limitation, not silently treated as the production renderer
design.outcome_use: No new-cohort/evaluation registration results may select step, perturbation or acceptance criteria
design.review_policy: Describe numerical differences across all four h values. No retrospective success threshold or automatic optimizer change; any setting change requires a prospective protocol amendment using only old-development numerical evidence.
